event_corrections.source: Before (1245.07) and after (1245.27) crops fr/g1/i15b.png and sheet fr/g1/i15.png: the T rotates into the slot on the stack, no row is removed (every row identical, the row it lands in has empty cells at cols 1-2), banner reads T-SPIN (mini). Score +300 at 1245.23 (58097->58397) = zero-line Mini T-spin at level 3; a Mini T-spin Single would be +600. Lock with no clear.

Crops 1381.20 vs 1381.47 fr/g1/i17.png: T placed upright into its slot, every row of the stack unchanged, no line cleared; SPIN banner. Score +300 at 1381.40 (89629->89929) = zero-line Mini T-spin, not a Mini Single (+600).

Sheet fr/g1/i21.png 506.00-506.54: T into a two-row slot, two coloured (non-garbage) rows flash and clear, banners 'T-SPIN Double' + 'BACK to BACK'. Score +5400 at 506.30 (119550->124950) = B2B TSD (3600x1.5); a TST would be 7200.

Winner p2's last piece: Z spawns 510.667 (nextcount shift ZLOJZ>LOJZO), hard-dropped and locked with flash on frame 510.733 = the KO frame (end_s 510.73), score +20 at 510.73 (127428->127448); crops fr/g1/i22b.png. No clear. Chain's last event is 510.27 (S, locked ~510.57). The +150 'KO-tail jump' 508.43->510.20 is only hard-drop points over 7 locks while the score was hidden (sheet fr/g1/i22.png, no clears).

Online lag freeze 547-554 (both boards and falling pieces frozen while the in-game timer runs; sheet fr/g1/i23.png). p2 spawns only one piece between 545.0 and 554.63 (nextcount: shift 545.000 TOSJT>OSJTZ, next shift 554.633): the T, which locks at ~553.95 as Mini T-SPIN Single with '9 REN' banner, score +1950 at 553.97 (600+150x9). Score 24866 (544.73, 8 REN single) -> 24871 (drops only) -> 26821: no clear at 545.07, no lock at 549.67, no REN break (banners 8 REN, 9 REN, 10 REN at 556.0). So 545.0 and 553.9 tsmini are one clear, 545.07 single and 549.67 lock are phantoms, BREAK is false.

p1 spawns (nextcount): L 545.067 (held, Z out -> single 545.67, 3 REN), O 545.933 (held at 547.80, L out of hold), next spawn S 556.267. L sat through the lag freeze 547-554 (fr/g1/i23.png) and cleared at 555.63 (+900 = 4 REN single). Score 35776 -> 35779 from 545.67 to 555.57: no clear here.

Same evidence: only the L (from hold) locks between 545.93 and the S spawn at 556.267. Score jumps after 555.63 are 556.83,557.70,558.80,559.90,560.43,561.27,562.10,563.20 (REN 5..11 then plain single) = 8, matched by chain events 556.3..563.1; 545.93 is the L (REN 4, score 555.63); 555.9 is an extra single.
